headline_item.title_zh: AI搞钱能力突飞猛进：已能搞定41%自由职业任务
headline_item.title_en: Anthropic's Fable 5.2 completes 41 percent of real freelance jobs, up from 2.5 percent a year ago
headline_item.event_summary_zh: Anthropic的Fable 5.2模型在远程劳动指数测试中完成41.3%的专业任务，效率实现指数级跳跃
headline_item.event_summary_en: Anthropic's Fable 5.2 model has achieved a 41.3% success rate on the Remote Labor Index, completing professional freelance projects at a standard acceptable to paying clients. This represents a 16-fold increase in capability since the benchmark's inception a year ago, signaling a massive leap in agentic productivity.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Anthropic在远程劳动指数（RLI）评估：Fable 5.2模型能够高质量完成41.3%的真实自由职业任务
【起因与机理】AI智能体技术迭代迅速，从辅助生成转向能够独立交付的劳动实体
【关键数据与实测】一年内完成率从2.5%提升至41.3%。
【观点态度】AI向具备专业交付能力的智能体演进。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Anthropic (Remote Labor Index (RLI) testing): Fable 5.2 model completes 41.3% of real freelance professional tasks
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Rapid iteration in AI agents transforming them into autonomous professional workers
[Key Metrics] Completion rate surged from 2.5% to 41.3% in a year.
[Perspective & Impact] Evolution toward commercially viable professional AI agents.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 以前我们讨论AI会不会抢饭碗，现在数据直接告诉你：AI已经把40%的饭碗端走了。当AI智能体比人类实习生更高效且不闹脾气时，自由职业市场的生态恐怕要经历一场血腥的重构了。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: We used to ask if AI would take our jobs; now the stats suggest it's already clearing half the plate. When an AI agent is more reliable and efficient than your average freelancer, the 'gig economy' is about to get a lot more competitive—and a lot less human.

headlines.event_summary_zh: Anthropic正式确认IPO计划，拟登陆纳斯达克，发行价区间定在70-78美元
headlines.event_summary_en: Anthropic has confirmed its upcoming IPO, planning to list on the Nasdaq with shares priced between $70 and $78. While falling short of the most ambitious $2 trillion valuation rumors, the move signals a major milestone in the AI sector's public market debut race.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Anthropic在纳斯达克（Nasdaq）：宣布IPO计划，发行价70-78美元，代号“ANT
【起因与机理】作为AI独角兽通过上市获取长期资本支撑，应对白热化的模型研发竞赛
【关键数据与实测】发行价确认为70-78美元。
【观点态度】登陆纳斯达克，股票代号“ANT。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Anthropic (Nasdaq Global Select Market): IPO with share price set at $70-$78 under ticker 'ANT
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Capitalizing on the AI boom to fuel long-term R&D in a highly competitive market
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 估值从2万亿回调到万亿规模，这是资本市场在疯狂过后终于开始算细账了。当“生成式AI”褪去神话光环，剩下的就是真刀真枪的现金流博弈，二级市场的韭菜们准备好迎接这场资本大戏了吗？
headlines.industry_impact_en: The valuation haircut from $2T to $1T shows the market is finally asking: 'Okay, but where's the profit?' It's the transition from speculative AI hype to the grim reality of fundamental finance, and the IPO launch is just the opening bell of the long-term struggle for dominance.

titans.quote_zh:
人们应该始终掌控未来。

OpenAI 反对这样一种观念，即人们被降级到做“人工智能系统认为对人类有意义的奖励”的事情是可以接受的。

titans.quote_en:
People should always be in control of the future.

OpenAI is against the notion that it would be acceptable for people to be relegated to a role of doing things that “AI systems think makes sense to reward in humans”.

People should not cede control of the future to superintelligence, and that requirement should ultimately constrain AI progress.
